column1: # Kashmiri word gold set, written 2026-11-18 from the sources below before the Kashmiri rules were run on
# these items. Format: word, pronunciation(s) separated by |, category, source. Categories: arab = word in
# the Perso-Arabic script, num = numeral in the Perso-Arabic script, deva = word in Devanagari. Sources:
# W = Wiktionary, Kashmiri entry with a pronunciation (English Wiktionary, Category:Kashmiri terms with IPA
# pronunciation, CC BY-SA 4.0, as extracted by kaikki.org from the dump of 2026-10-01, read 2026-11-18):
# the headword and every pronunciation the entry gives (phonemic or phonetic); N = the same for
# Wiktionary's Kashmiri numerals; D = the Devanagari spelling that the same entry gives for the word, with
# the entry's pronunciation. Entries of more than one word, letters and affixes are left out. Nothing was
# changed in the pronunciations: Wiktionary's notation varies (w and ʋ, r and ɾ, j and ʲ after a
# consonant, tie bars, dental marks, optional vowels in parentheses), and the evaluation compares a broad
# transcription (tools/eval/bho_eval.py) in which these are made one; some entries disagree with each
# other (پانٛژھ pãːt͡sʰ against پٲنٛژھ pə̃ːt͡sʰ), and both are kept as written.
# Kashmiri sentence gold set, written 2026-11-18 before the Kashmiri rules were run on these items.
# Perso-Arabic (the first 32): lines of AI4Bharat IndicCorp v2 Kashmiri text (CC0) in none of
# tools/eval/data/ks_dev.tsv, ks_heldout.tsv and ks_wiki.tsv (the IndicCorp sentences of the development
# half of the hash that the development set did not draw), chosen among the lines whose words are either
# written with their vowel marks or written without any (lines with words that leave out some vowel marks
# and keep others, which no convention reads, were passed over); an empty pair of brackets was left out.
# Devanagari (the last 10): ten of those lines written in Kashmiri Devanagari by hand (the 2009
# proposal: ऺ ऻ for ə əː, ॖ ॗ for ɨ ɨː, ॆ ॊ for e o, ्य for palatalisation; a halant where a consonant
# has no vowel and Hindi-type reading would give it one), with the same pronunciation as the line they
# copy. Pronunciation hand-written word by word from the letter values of the orthography (the Wikipedia
# article "Kashmiri language", section "Writing system"): a consonant without a vowel mark in a word that
# writes its vowels has none (cluster), a word-final ہ after a vowel mark carries it and is silent, ؠ is ʲ
# at the end of a word and ʲa inside it, ٛ on ی after a consonant is ʲ, ن with ٛ is a nasal consonant after
# a short vowel and before a consonant and a nasal vowel after a long one, medial ی is eː and یٖ iː, و is
# oː and وٗ uː; words written without vowel marks as they are said (راجستھان raːdʒastʰaːn, از az, فون
# foːn). These sentences test that the rules follow the conventions they were written from, not how
# speakers say the words. Format: sentence <TAB> pronunciation.
# Columns: id, kind, text, expected, category, source (with licence), split, date written.
